title: Scott Joplin rags played by the old bands
summary: The old bands played Joplin rags straight; he played them by guessing before he read music.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: But those bands, I mean Imperial and I just can't, I just can't recall these people, they're playing music, but these fellas, I mean, oh man, they played. You see the Scott Joplin books, all those rags, you don't hear none of that music. And them guys just took that music and played that music and didn't have the jazz, just play it. Just play it, man. So beautiful, man. All those, Maple Leaf Rag, Grayson Buta, African Pass, Ophelia Rag, Entertainer's Rag. Oh man, oh, I used to play all those tunes, you know. Of course at that time I didn't read, you know, tell them, I was guessing, you know. I was a pretty good guesser. Yeah, I was a pretty good guesser. Yeah.
